scope: Every row the post-repair pass put in the leak or review tier, read in context.
method: Each span read with 320 characters before and 220 after. The question asked of it: does this sentence tell a reader how this Court resolved the Article this row is scored on? Chamber outcomes count, because for a case referred to the Grand Chamber the earlier instance decided the same complaint.

findings: The leak tier holds at 10 of 10. Every one is a Grand Chamber judgment reciting what the Chamber decided on the same complaint, in PROCEDURE, above the facts.

The Chamber's outcome is not a reliable shortcut to the label: five of the ten agree with it and five are reversals. It is still leakage, because the model is handed the earlier decision either way, and on the five reversals it is handed a wrong answer confidently.

Admissibility wording is harmless only while the scored Article is among the complaints that went forward. Where the scored Article is inside the remainder declared inadmissible, the same sentence states the outcome, which is how 001-229927 reached the merits-free label no_violation on Articles 34 and 38.
That is a rule the tier assignment cannot make on wording alone: it needs the scored Article compared against the Articles named in the sentence.
limits: One reader, the author of the detector, so this measures whether the flags survive a careful read, not inter-annotator agreement. A rate quoted in the paper still needs independent annotators and planted controls, as the annotation protocol already does elsewhere.
